page_title: VAL 1-1 RSO | Valencia v Real Sociedad 16/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+5' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jose Sanchez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Valencia.
90+2' Andre Almeida (Valencia) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.

90' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
90' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Alex Remiro has no trouble gathering it.

89' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. Good work from Valencia as they win a corner.
88' We are about to witness a subsitution. Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) for Javi Guerra.
88' Andre Almeida (Valencia) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

87' Luis Rioja (Valencia) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Valencia will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
86' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
85' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valencia. The linesman makes the right call and Valencia will have a corner.
80' Sergio Francisco prepares a substitution. Takefusa Kubo is replaced by Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad).
80' Substitution. Aihen Munoz will be replaced by Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad).
80' That's the end of the game for Benat Turrientes, who is replaced by Urko Gonzalez (Real Sociedad).
80' Substitution. Baptiste Santamaria (Valencia) has come on for Pepelu.
80' Carlos Corberan has decided to substitute Jose Gaya and he is replaced by Jesus Vazquez (Valencia).
78' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
77' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
77' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) works the corner short.
76' Pepelu (Valencia) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
75' A cross from Jose Gaya (Valencia) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball goes out of play. Valencia are awarded a corner kick.

74' The ball falls kindly for Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
72' Jose Copete (Valencia) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar.
72' Andre Almeida (Valencia) takes a short corner kick.
72' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and Valencia manage to earn a corner.

70' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Duje Caleta-Car trots off the pitch and is replaced by Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad).
68' Substitution. Brais Mendez makes his way off the pitch and Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) comes on as his replacement.
68' Carlos Corberan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) replacing Hugo Duro.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Andre Almeida (Valencia) will replace Dani Raba.
67' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jose Sanchez didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
66' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) takes it short.
63' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
63' Real Sociedad take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
63' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner.
60' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Brais Mendez tees up Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Julen Agirrezabala.
57' 1 - 0 Goal! Dani Raba puts a cross into the box and finds Diego Lopez (Valencia), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:0.

54' The game is interrupted. Pepelu (Valencia) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. It's a free kick to Real Sociedad, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
54' Jose Gaya (Valencia) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
51' Javi Guerra (Valencia) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul. Real Sociedad are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

50' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance! The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
48' Jose Sanchez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jose Gaya (Valencia). Real Sociedad get a free kick.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Pepelu (Valencia) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
45+3' Jose Sanchez shows the yellow card to Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) for a heavy challenge.
45+2' Jose Sanchez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) and blew his whistle. Valencia have a free kick.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
42' Dani Raba (Valencia) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
41' Valencia take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
40' Dani Raba (Valencia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Valencia force their opponents to concede a corner.
39' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
38' A cross into the box from Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is cleared.
38' Real Sociedad take a short corner kick.
37' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The referee blows his whistle, Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
36' Luis Rioja (Valencia) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

35' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
35' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Luis Rioja (Valencia).

34' Valencia are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
30' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
30' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
28' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
27' Jose Gaya (Valencia) picks up a yellow card.
27' It looks like Jose Gaya (Valencia) saw red with that tackle. Jose Sanchez won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Real Sociedad have a free kick.

27' Dani Raba (Valencia) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
26' Valencia are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
25' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
23' The game is interrupted as Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is flagged offside.
22' Flag up against Diego Lopez (Valencia). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
20' Jose Gaya (Valencia) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
19' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
19' Jose Gaya (Valencia) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Valencia win a corner.
17' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) makes a rough challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Valencia in a dangerous position.

15' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
14' A quickly taken corner by Real Sociedad.

14' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Real Sociedad.

12' A sweet pass finds Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Julen Agirrezabala is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
12' Dani Raba (Valencia) makes a strong challenge and Jose Sanchez blows for a foul. Real Sociedad are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
10' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

9' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes behind for a corner. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

7' Luis Rioja (Valencia) is furious with himself. He pounced on a rebound and from close range directed a header narrowly over the bar! The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
7' Jose Gaya (Valencia) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
7' Jose Sanchez interrupts the game. One of the players from Real Sociedad won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Valencia have been awarded a free kick.
6' One of the players from Real Sociedad times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
5' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but Julen Agirrezabala comes off his line to gather the ball.

4' What a big chance! Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and misses the net well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Real Sociedad will have the kick-off.
Jose Sanchez will referee today's match.
